x: Eric Gebbett ran with great determination to hold off the opposition on Stage 2, but had to give way to T.V.H (Stacey) by 14 seconds, with Blackheath (Sibley) moving to third 11 seconds away.

After nearly 2 miles of pace-setting by Stacey (T.V.H.), Bill with Longridge (S.L.H.) broke clear. With 660 yards to go our runner made his effort and managed to hold off his opponent's noted finish until the last 50 yards.
At Purley Ron overtook Stacey of T.V.H. and we were fifth at the change-over, 77secs. behind Portsmouth who had consolidated their lead and were never again to be headed.
